title: The filter made by the context transition is added to the outer filter context

source.quote: CALCULATE makes a copy of the original filter context to prepare the new filter context.
source.supports: the new filter context starts as a copy of the original one (Year = 2023); the transition's filter on Color is applied to that copy

source.quote: A filter applied on the “one” side of a relationship affects the rows of the table on the “many” side of that relationship, but the filter does not propagate in the opposite direction.
source.supports: the filter on Date reaches Sales but not Product, so VALUES ( Product[Color] ) still has the three colors

derivation: Under Date[Year] = 2023 the Sales rows are 1, 2, 3, 4. Red (Bike, Helmet): rows 1, 2, 3 = 100 + 40 + 20 = 160. Blue (Lock): row 4 = 50. Green: none, BLANK. The filter on Date does not filter Product, so all three colors are iterated.
notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases.
